reason: Losing two big customers hurts, so I'd take the free 15-company sample, but I won't put EUR 1,500 down this month. I paid an agency before and got reports, not customers, and in our business a cold email from a domain nobody knows doesn't turn into a real buyer the way a handshake at a fair does.
objection: A meeting isn't a customer. I can get five calls with people who are 'just looking' and still owe the second half, and after the last agency I don't believe strangers' outreach will bring serious buyers for our products.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample list has companies I actually recognise as good fits and couldn't reach myself, and the past client you put me in touch with is a manufacturer like us who tells me those meetings turned into orders, not just calls.
